title: Pair response
description: The Device's id and token, from POST /v1/pair once or from POST /v1/devices/me/token when the token is replaced (D6). The Hub keeps only SHA-256(token). Open.

token.description: Opaque bearer token (E19): a client stores and sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token> and never parses it. The characters are those a bearer credential may hold (RFC 6750).
